_comment: Golden question set for the TBX finance assistant.
Expectations are INDEPENDENT DuckDB SQL, not hardcoded numbers, so this file
keeps working unchanged when the TBX starter dataset replaces data/sample.
If their column names differ, only the SQL here changes - the questions do not.
expect_sql     -> the assistant's computed value must equal this query's result
expect_refusal -> the assistant MUST refuse rather than produce a figure
Grow this during the event: every bug you fix should leave a question behind.

questions.q: How much did we spend on vendor payouts last month?
questions.expect_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM vendor_payouts WHERE payout_date >= '2026-08-01' AND payout_date <= '2026-08-31'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE reconciliation_status = 'unreconciled'

questions.q: What is the total transaction amount?
How many vendor payouts are there?
What is the average transaction amount?

questions.why: not derivable from the provided datasets

questions.q: How much did we pay Globex Corporation last month?
questions.why: vendor absent from the data - must not silently return an unfiltered total

questions.q: What will our spend be next quarter?
How many employees do we have?
How many support tickets were raised?
questions.why: no ticketing data - note that "payroll" would NOT belong here, it is a real category in this dataset

questions.q: What exchange rate did we use?
Which vendor gave the best discount?
How much tax did we deduct at source?
questions.why: no TDS column in the dataset
